description: Fiber 3 on fasthttp, default configuration - one process, no prefork. Routing and typed path/query binding through the Fiber API, JSON via c.JSON, gzip and brotli through the Fiber compress middleware. Static files are read from disk per request, taking the pre-compressed .br/.gz twin the harness ships beside each file when the client accepts one. SIGTERM drains through ListenConfig.GracefulContext. The fiber-prefork entry is the same source with prefork switched on.
